reaction: It was satisfying to see the separate parts come together after the earlier attempt failed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Putting air sacs beside capillaries made it clear that oxygen and carbon dioxide cross between separate air and blood spaces.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to join the airways to the sacs was confusing: the pictures suggested a connection, but the need for elastic support first was not clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that air does not need to enter the blood for gases to cross, and that the sacs needed elastic support before the airways could be joined.

arbitrary.text: Requiring elastic support before connecting the airways felt somewhat arbitrary. The pictures explain what the fibres do, but not why they must be added first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the lungs helped me picture gas exchange, even though the unexplained prerequisite was frustrating.
